budget.input_bound: Full logical JSON bytes plus 1024 image-token allowance and at least 512 marker allowance.
budget.over_bound_usage: Unusable result with unknown full reservation held; no inflated settlement.
budget.unknown_attempt_identity: Original reservation retained; never dispatch under the same observation identity again.

privacy.export: Case-bound allowlist projection, excluding customer session hashes and purchaser gift data.
privacy.individual_erase_and_retention: Delete linked unheld image receipts and canonical bytes; retain original unknown budget identity.
privacy.holds: Preserve held evidence. Consent withdrawal revokes approval in place; uninstall revokes all configuration versions and sessions.
privacy.restore_and_import: Delete nonportable image records and revoke configuration; refuse held image copies for separate retention administration.

evaluation: Cohort specification and proposed metrics/thresholds frozen; actual authorized membership, independent labels and image inference pending. Wire answers are not quality measurements.
history_reconciliation: Missing later M15/M16/M23 implementation must be restored and reconciled before integration. Recovered main is unchanged.
